games.name: [GAMEPLAY REVAMP!] Project Egoist
games.desc:
Welcome to Project Egoist!

🖥️ PC Control :
Q - Dribble
E - Steal / SideDash
R - Super Dash
T - Request Ball
F - Flow State Awaken
M1 - Shoot Ball
M2 - Pass Ball
Z, X, C, V - Skills
Ctrl - Run

🎮 Console Control : 
Press Left Stick (L3) - Run
Y / Triangle (△) - Super Dash
X / Square (□) - Dribble
B / Circle (○) - Steal
RT / R2 -Shoot Ball
LT / L2 - Pass Ball / Request Ball
LB / L1 - Skill1
RB / R1 - Skill2
D-Pad Down - Flow State Awaken (Hold for Emote)
D-Pad Left - Skill3
D-Pad Right - Skill4
D-Pad Up - Shiftlock


⚙️You can change keybinds as well as Mobile Buttons in settings!

Special Thanks to D.Meletis for OST!

games.name: Absolvement [ALPHA]
games.desc:
An end of a lifetime, or the beginning of an era? Nobody knows what lies at the end. In fact, most believe there is no end. You struggle to differentiate between your true memories and false ones planted from your fleeting consciousness as you shatter your body but not your soul.

<> Absolvement is currently in the ALPHA development stage. <>
Fundamentals of the game may change as we release updates!

- Play solo or in parties up to 5 players
- Branded by sins, affixes, and burdens - freely choose your rate of progression and your own personal difficulty
- Classless character design and progression
- Over 130 abilities to use and build synergies with
- Earn Soul Fragments when your character wipes to unlock 200+ buffs in the Soul Tree for your next character

Absolvement is a roguelite dungeon crawler developed by Amorian Skies.
Nominated in the 2025 Creator Awards for Best Narrative.
All in-game music is our own composed OST! 
Playable on PC and Console with controller support.

games.name: Indo Voice
games.desc:
Welcome to Indo Voice!

Enter a colorful social world where your voice is the center of attention! Indo Voice is our 4th creation, continuing a long tradition of delivering the best social experience. As the pioneer of hangout games in Indonesia since 2014, we have dedicated more than a decade to perfecting the art of play and socialization.

💖 Features & Activities:
- Connect - Meet and chat with friends from all over Indonesia! 🇮🇩
- Voice Chat - Real-time chat for a more realistic experience! 🗣️
- Appreciate - Give & Receive Hearts to share a positive aura!
- Express - Share stories, jokes, or sing your favorite song! 🎶
- Fish & Play - Be on the edge while fishing or playing mini-games! 🎣🎮
- Customize - Look different with exclusive Aura, Trail, Pet, and Tools! ✨
- Vibe - Show off your style with a variety of dance emotes and movements! 🕺
